cbdtp.name: Central Business District Tolling Program
cbdtp.law: MTA Reform and Traffic Mobility Act, Part ZZZ of Chapter 59 of the Laws of 2019
cbdtp.statute: N.Y. Vehicle and Traffic Law Article 44-C, sections 1701-1706
cbdtp.who_runs_it: Triborough Bridge and Tunnel Authority (MTA Bridges and Tunnels)
cbdtp.zone: Manhattan south of and including 60th Street
excluded_roads: surface roadway portion of the Hugh L. Carey Tunnel connecting to West Street
cbdtp.who_pays: Vehicles entering or remaining in the zone. Stay-only travel on the excluded roads is not tolled. Exit from an excluded road onto a local street in the zone is tolled.
cbdtp.passenger_and_motorcycle: Charged once per day. Statute bars more than one daily toll on passenger vehicles registered under VTL 401(6).
cbdtp.peak: 5 a.m. to 9 p.m. weekdays; 9 a.m. to 9 p.m. weekends
cbdtp.overnight_rule: 75 percent less than the matching peak rate. No crossing credits overnight.

street_trees.fy25_source: NYC Parks Commissioner Susan Donoghue to City Council Parks Committee, 2025-03-20
street_trees.fy24_source: Parks figure reported by Forest for All NYC
street_trees.validation_note: FY25 $3,110 citywide planting average attributed to Commissioner Susan Donoghue at the March 20, 2025 Council hearing, 0:46:17. 180 × $3,110 = $559,800 is an illustrative planting component, not a full program quote.

green_infrastructure.ddc_avg_note: NYC Comptroller audit of 545 DDC rain gardens under guarantee in FY2020-2021
green_infrastructure.validation_note: Historical citywide program references are not committed funding or eligibility for this site. Specific contract/program details were not all reverified in this repair.

klyde_warren.covers: Phase I park deck + park amenities over recessed Woodall Rodgers Freeway. Public-private: City of Dallas $20M bonds, TxDOT $20M, federal stimulus $16.7M, private balance.
klyde_warren.not_this_number: A ~$2B to $2.5B figure is not the park deck build cost. Public cites for ~$2B (and later higher) are economic-development / growth claims around the park, not construction. Separate Dallas highway rebuilds (e.g. I-30 Canyon ~$888M) and convention-center programs (up to multi-billion) are also not Klyde Warren's sticker.

phase2_expansion.note: Separate later deck expansion west of St. Paul / toward Akard. NCTCOG funding tables show construction totals near $111M to $125M as design matured; not part of the original $110M–$112M Phase I.

southern_gateway_halperin.place: Dallas, I-35E Oak Cliff / Southern Gateway (Halperin Park)
southern_gateway_halperin.note: Another Dallas deck-park family member. Park agreement ~$172M; some reporting folds in highway widening / cap work toward ~$300M. Not Klyde Warren.

highway_lid.project_span_note: Archived 12.9-acre illustrative corridor footprint, not surveyed land or the area of the compact 240 m × 34 m (2.02 acre) model.
highway_lid.band_note: Archived assumed $20M–$90M/acre band: 12.9 × $20M = $258M; 12.9 × $90M = $1.161B. Klyde Warren supports a historical low-end precedent only; the high end was not independently validated in this repair. This is not a price for the compact model.
highway_lid.owner: Coordinate with roadway and land owners. Applicable structural, environmental and land-use approvals depend on the project; no legal approval pathway or construction schedule is established here.

truck_rules.cbdtp: Trucks pay on every zone entry. Overnight E-ZPass in 2025-2027 is $3.60 for small single-unit trucks and $5.40 for large multi-unit trucks, 75 percent under peak.
truck_rules.nyc_truck_routes: 34 RCNY 4-13. A truck is two axles and six tires, or three or more axles. Through trucks stay on through truck routes. Local trucks use local truck routes and leave them only for the most direct last-mile trip.
truck_rules.night_parking: 34 RCNY 4-08(k)(6). No commercial-vehicle parking on a residential street from 9 p.m. to 5 a.m., with stated business and utility exceptions.
truck_rules.street_storage: 34 RCNY 4-08(k)(5). No commercial vehicle parked more than three hours where parking is otherwise allowed.
